# Primary source: Chrysler TN-AP-67-158 (NASA-CR-89333)
# Table 5 "AS-205 Revised L/V Reference Trajectory — S-IB Stage Flight Data"
# Printed pages 17–21 (PDF pages ~24–28 on ibiblio scan)
# Units (converted to SI for obliq compare):
#   t_s       — flight time from first motion (s); TN "FLIGHT TIME (SEC)"
#   h_m       — altitude (m) = TN ALTITUDE (KM) * 1000
#   v_mps     — space-fixed velocity (m/s) as printed (includes Earth-rate residual ~409 m/s at t=0)
#   gamma_rad — space-fixed flight path angle (rad) = TN (DEG) * pi/180
#   mass_kg   — vehicle mass (kg) as printed
#   qbar_Pa   — dynamic pressure (Pa) = TN "DYNAMIC PRESSURE (KG/M2)" * 9.80665
#               (TN kg/m² treated as kgf/m²; spot-check: max-q ~3254 → ~31.9 kPa ~666 psf)
# Notes for model comparison (tread carefully):
#   - TN v is space-fixed; open-loop 9.x demos use body |v_b| and start near rest → do not
#     expect |v| match at t=0. Prefer altitude and mass for first residual checks.
#   - Simulink saturn-1B stack may deviate from these TN values; prefer TN when debugging.
#   - Digitized by human-assisted vision OCR of scanned pages; spot-checked mass continuity
#     (Δm/Δt ~ 2700–2800 kg/s under boost). Re-verify any outlier against the PDF before
#     treating residuals as model bugs.
